notes.title: Weekly Update!
notes.notes: [p]Lots of feedback rolled into this week's build. More eye-catching UI. New ways to cultivate seeds and saplings. Your deeds and cashmoney (and crafting station progress) are now saved in [i]A Place to Call Home[/i]. All good stuff. [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Item tooltips now show how many of that item you have, in parenthesis after the name, if you have more than zero[/p][/*][*][p]Item tooltips now show the item size on the right edge of the subheader[/p][/*][*][p]Arts: mines, locked plots, cultivators, and bill coin added[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting job state from the 'A Place to Call Home' level is now persistent; If you leave while a job was counting down, it will still be counting down when you return[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with the Cruft Tally being incorrect when loading a level that had cruft already on the ground, such as the persistent yard[/p][/*][*][p]When you level up, the xp bar turns into a button that allows you to collect your deeds.,[/p][/*][*][p]The old popup that appeared when you level up has been removed[/p][/*][*][p]When your Cashmoney, Deeds, or Cruft tallies change, the numbers pulse a little and tick towards the new value[/p][/*][*][p]The market and dump buttons have a new style to match the redesigned stat UI[/p][/*][*][p]Seed and Sapling Cultivators[/p][list][*][p]Can be built at the Drafting Table once you complete a new Cheevo[/p][/*][*][p]Each takes in grown items and outputs a lot of seeds/saplings appropriate to what went in[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Shops may now buy or sell or trade in deeds[/p][/*][*][p]To craft a recipe, you now have to have all the required ingredients in the same location as the station. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Tutorial Updated Muchly:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]The tutorial is now more free-form and reveals the relevant recipes in a new UI panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial now explains Cheevos a bit better[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial messages now appear closer to their subjects where possible, or centered near the top of the screen, instead of on the phone.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial now explains that cashmoney does not carry over when you leave[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial now explains that levels are reset when you leave[/p][/*][*][p]Tim sells all the tutorial items in the tutorial and now buys pizza[/p][/*][*][p]Location Features no longer display the deed icon or cost value before you are allowed to unlock the magnet during the tutorial.[/p][/*][/list][p][i][u]If you had an older version of the tutorial in-progress when you update and resume that game, you will see the van transition animation and be brought to the start of the new tutorial.[/u][/i] [/p][p][/p][p][b]And More!:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Plots, pens, and ponds updated[/p][/*][*][p]The first shop you get in a level is now randomly selected from all of that characters shops.[/p][/*][*][p]The R and F keys zoom the camera in and out. Hold Shift to zoom faster.[/p][/*][*][p]You can hold the shift key to WASD faster too[/p][/*][*][p]Chimkn breakdown recipes added to butcher block and station[/p][/*][*][p]Updated pop up backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]The dump button now says "Drive to Dump" for consistency and clarity in the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]The Pick Next Yard screen now shows all the levels you have unlocked thus far.[/p][/*][*][p]Sizable pass on item/shop availability. Some items like maple saplings should be a bit easier to find, albeit not everywhere.[/p][/*][*][p]Roadside Finds shop is a little more stingy per refresh, but has a much wider variety of things to get for free overall.[/p][/*][*][p]Van is now blue! notes.title: Pork Tamales Build is LIVE
notes.notes: [p][b]BUILD NOTES[/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]New Level[/b]: A Place To Call Home[/p][list][*][p]This level is persistent. When you leave and come back it will be the way you left it... stuff and all. Well really just the stuff. See the known issues below. You can stockpile stuff here for future runs. You can vibe out here and do whatever you like.[/p][/*][*][p]There are (almost) no characters for now. Just an option to junk pick at the side of the road. Characters will get added in later once we've beat up this level a bit.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Realtor text to tell you the (no longer) secret way to get to the (no longer) secret level. This text shows up when no level is selected in the Realtor app AFTER you have completed the whole tutorial (including the first time you pick a new yard).[/p][/*][*][p]The level is HUGE. If we are going to run into performance issues this place will be the crucible. Please let us know if the game slows are gets otherwise crufty here.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p][u]Known Issues with A Place To Call Home:[/u][/p][list][*][p]Your Cruft count in the top HUD will be incorrect. It appears to be fine under the hood but the display in the top HUD is just misbehaving.[/p][/*][*][p]Your Cashmoney resets when you return. It's supposed to persist here.[/p][/*][*][p]Your XP will be reset when you enter. It's supposed to persist here.[/p][/*][*][p]Stations that processing recipes don't save their progress when you leave. You have been warned. Let them thangs finish before you head out.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Shipping it with the known issues as it is still very cool to play and you are opting in by typing in a secret code and that is practically a signature. Go have fun. We'll keep working on it.[/i] [i]It adds a whole new dimension to the game.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Misc:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced shop refresh time 300s->150s[/p][/*][*][p]Updated bill coin pieces text to be more clue-y[/p][/*][*][p]Recalibrated and extended XP curve[/p][list][*][p]Extended out levels to 100 (though it will be pretty wild if anyone gets there any time soon),[/p][/*][*][p]Refactored the xp curve to be more shallow. Note: it may be tooo fast right now so we will revisit in a later update once folks have played the persistent level a bit more.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tutorial: moved magnet plot to a more visible location[/p][/*][*][p]Added more store descriptions[/p][/*][/list][p] Arts! notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes: [p]Early Access is going great! We continue to get more players into the game and we're getting awesome feedback via the [url="https://discord.gg/X3XpPn7uw8"]discord[/url]. I'd like to take the time to let y'all in on what our next steps are. Timeframe is TBD on the big stuff.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Big Stuff:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Better UI:[/p][/*][/list][p]There is a lot to click in CRUFT. We're taking the time to make that experience feel better. Some contextual tool tips, more information, more of that information closer to where you need it. It's worth it and your mouse hand will appreciate it.[/p][list][*][p]A place to call home:[/p][/*][/list][p]A new level with persistence. A place that sticks around that you can choose to go to rather than a fresh start on one of the Realtor's picks. It would have much longer term play potential, would be sandbox play, and could serve as a place to stockpile important items. Further details TBD in terms of how you get it or any other special sauce involved. [/p][p]This one is kind of a doozy. It should change the game pretty profoundly in some ways, but still feel familiar. It is basically an extra layer of progression that lets you always go back to a certain spot and just craft whatever you like. It should also be a cool spot to take screenshots and show off a bunch of cool stuff you have made. If you like CRUFT, this place should be the comfort food version of play that you keep coming back to.[/p][list][*][p]More narrative and character love:[/p][/*][/list][p]We've always envisioned the characters being a bit more than just stores. We'd love it if the characters texted you sometimes with info, maybe some cool deal, or perhaps reacted to what you are doing. I love getting texts from Tim irl and I imagine you will love getting them in game. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Not-as-big-but-wicked-important-stuff:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Optimally weekly updates. Fixes and enhancements to stuff like:[/p][list][*][p]Game balance[/p][/*][*][p]Art (we have an artist now!)[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes and tech sorcery improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Incorporation of feedback (you guys are the best [img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1381662592094699530.webp?size=44"][/img] )[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Intermittent content updates. Not every week, but substantial level ups in content when they are ready:[/p][list][*][p]New levels[/p][/*][*][p]New branches of crafting[/p][/*][*][p]New characters[/p][/*][*][p]New Cheevos[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Achievements as we settle in on Cheevo balance. We would like the Steam achievements to be 1:1 with the Cheevo requirements so when we feel like things are reasonably balanced we'll set up the Steam side and you can watch your Steam achievement count balloon up.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]We have other ideas but right now they are murky in terms of design, scope, or whether they make sense to do after the full release. "A place to call home" as a concept was never a part of the original design and now through play and feedback it seems super important. I want to leave enough breathing room for things like that to bubble up. The point here is that what may end up being one of the biggest features of the game is being driven by your feedback. That's pretty cool.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for riding shotgun in our van![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Early Access Is LIVE!!!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Gang![/p][p][/p][p]We're very excited to be getting Cruft into Early Access. It's been a while since we did a community update, but rest assured we've been hard at work. Here's a bit of what we have worked on:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The tutorial now guides players through the basics of the game including how to craft, how to make cash money, and how to choose to move on to a new yard.[/p][/*][*][p]You can get "Cheevos" for crafting certain lists of items and then moving on to a new yard. Cheevos give you permanent bonuses on subsequent playthroughs. If you're ever lost for what to do next, check the Cheevos app.[/p][/*][*][p]We've made a ton of improvements to the overall presentation and flow of the game based on feedback from the Demo.[/p][/*][*][p]There are multiple levels! Each has it's own flavor and degree of challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]Hardening. We've taken a good chunk of time and made the game more durable. That's the nice way of saying that we've updated a bunch of code to operate better/faster/safer.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Early Access should be a fun ride. There's still lots more to add to the game with your feedback. Much more content to create, but also some whole new features to bring online. In the coming days I'll leak some more info on what the road ahead has in store.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyhoo, thanks a bunch for all the support so far. Feel free to drop into the Discord if you'd like to get in touch, and from all two of us here, we hope you enjoy watching Cruft grow.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494294/583747a9e791983e20f347696916d46ea5ad4373.png"][/img][/p]
